subject: Geopolitics
title: Solar and Wind Geopolitics
description: Learn Solar and Wind Geopolitics in one minute.

hook.text: Sunlight and wind can't be embargoed. Renewables promise energy that no foreign power can cut off.

buildup.text: Solar and wind are now the cheapest electricity sources in most countries. Costs dropped 90% in a decade.

discovery.text: Renewables shift power from resource-rich exporters to technology leaders.

twist.text: China makes 80% of the world's solar panels. The dependency shifts from oil exporters to tech manufacturers.

climax.text: Renewables reduce fossil fuel leverage but create new dependencies. The geopolitical game changes, it doesn't end.

punchline.text: New energy, new dependencies. The game never stops.

quiz.question: How does renewable energy change geopolitical power?
options: It eliminates all international energy competition
It shifts leverage from fuel exporters to tech manufacturers
It makes every nation fully energy independent
